program.name: Standing Wall Pilates
program.subject: Pilates
program.blurb: Short Pilates on your feet and against a wall: roll-downs, pliés and leg lifts.
program.about: Pilates without getting on the floor much. Roll-downs against the wall, pliés, standing leg lifts and heel raises, then a short mat finish. Two sessions alternate. Both later levels add reps.
